summary: SDD 2.4.0 publication (release.yml run 39789559347, attempt 1) pushed all four packages to GitHub Packages and nuget.org (each Created once) but its in-run readback gave up after 40 polls at 15 seconds (about 10 minutes) with nuget.org flat-container HTTP404, so the dual-feed receipt upload and the credential-free qualify-public job were skipped and the run ended red. The four archives first resolved on nuget.org about 27 minutes after the push; the v3 registration index followed within minutes; the GitHub Packages archives were byte-identical immediately. Absence from nuget.org inside this window is indexing lag, not a failed push, and must not trigger a push retry. The failed run is consumed; a red readback after a successful push is recovered by read-only verification and qualification of the already-published set, never by re-dispatching the publisher. The cited workflow is the state before the repair. Observation of one release, not a provider guarantee.
title: nuget.org indexing can outlast the in-run SDD publication readback
